answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 41588 Country: India Title: I want to know that if we pray salah behind a man who takes bribe (money) by giving dua and tawiz Question: I want to know that if we pray salah behind a man who takes bribe (money) by giving dua and tawiz? Answer ID: 41588 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 894/893/N=1433) It is lawful to take compensation on lawful dua and tawiz as per the Shariah. It is not bribe or haram hence you can offer salah behind such Amil. Yes, but it is not better and appropriate to make it a profession. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
